E-marked 7-side ''A Weakness Can Be Found'' slip showing the July 2016 text, which added Alderaan to the once-per-turn deployment option.

== Source ==

* Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222826id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/MasterList.pdf#page=23 Virtual Card Slips Master List], Set 3 Light Side, PDF p. 23, right column. Captured 6 August 2016.
* Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806182910id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-3.pdf#page=4 Virtual Set 3], PDF p. 4, right column. Captured 6 August 2016. This source renders the same pixels.

== File details ==

The publisher’s PDF panel was rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip, including the printed bottom margin and E mark.
